discordPostHtml:
yes... again a new CN mod translated by me as i have way too much time on my hands lol😅 anyway~...

A "neutral, friendly" courier company on the Hegemony's fringe. Cross them and their armed freighters will gladly give you a lift... as salvage.

Features

  • New faction and star system, built around Domain ruins
  • ~20 ships: armed freighters, carriers, battlecruisers and the Armistice industrial mothership
  • Custom fighters, RX Overlimit weapons and container VLS missiles
  • Hullmods that unlock powerful Deep Subsystems when built in
  • Corporate bonds, a VIP store and Miss Luo's Mystery Shop

**Forum Thread: ** https://github.com/MrPossible001/mirfak-parcel-service-english/releases/download/v0.7.4-EN/Mirfak.Parcel.Service.0.7.4-EN.zip

Fossic Link: https://www.fossic.org/thread-8355-1-1.html
Requires: Starsector 0.98 · LazyLib · MagicLib · GraphicLib · BoxUtil

hit me up on mistranslations or crashes k👍
